title: Interior, Local Authorities and Transport — measured pilot

ownership.note: Independent government directory names ministry host; old English fallback and legacy aliases are not substituted for the French pages.

conditions: Sequential Lighthouse 13.5.0 / Chrome 153 laboratory runs, up to three declared attempts per each of 3 predeclared pages on mobile and desktop; default simulated throttling and fresh browser processes. Per-pair successful-run counts and any unattempted runs are explicit; a collection stop is not a website failure. Operator network/geography unverified. Guarded DOM/axe observations use GET/HEAD and four-request concurrency; excluded requests can change rendering. No forms submitted, physical devices, field INP, full security audit, complete service process or 28-day reliability claim. Independent review pending. Different page samples are not a national comparison.
collectionNotes: 18 timing attempts recorded of 18 planned; 0 unattempted after collection limits.
3 distinct predeclared core page(s), with three attempts per page/device. Missing roles and narrower samples are not equivalent to complete website coverage.
homepage: guarded observation gaps retained; normal-browser follow-up is separate.
contact: guarded observation gaps retained; normal-browser follow-up is separate.
service-information: guarded observation gaps retained; normal-browser follow-up is separate.
The original root redirected to a sparse English landing page. The frozen sample uses observed French navigation URLs with separately verified HTTPS equivalents; both discoveries are retained.

All guarded captures timed out. In the separate follow-up, the French homepage was empty and the contact/procedure navigations exceeded the DOMContentLoaded timeout while yielding retained substantive text. Missing evidence is not a zero.

Default Node chain construction failed; only independently root-verified public intermediates were supplied. Full server chain delivery, universal client compatibility, transactions and privacy-law compliance remain unmeasured.

Completion review 2026-10-26 of the 21 October follow-up: 3 previously unmeasured criteria resolved, adding 5 assessed budget points. 2/3 additional core-page follow-ups were representative; excluded captures and original attempts are retained. Prior valid timing samples are unchanged. 36 criteria remain unmeasured; see the completion record for required evidence.

Supplementary GET search tasks, where present, use observed search forms and do not expand the original Lighthouse timing sample. Retained visual comparison is explicitly distinguished from fresh capture. Collector connection failures, robots exclusions and incomplete responses are never website zeros.

Coverage revision 2026-10-28: 2 further criteria resolved using explicit reviewed evidence. Restricted, untested and monitoring-dependent criteria remain unmeasured. Scores and measurement coverage are different quantities; no conversion of missing evidence to passes or zeros.

findings.title: Mobile homepage loading
findings.detail: Median lab LCP 17.01 seconds, range 15.90–17.79 seconds across three successful simulated runs. This operator-network result is not a field percentile or every visitor's experience.

findings.title: Verify the ministry contact email
findings.detail: The captured contact page publishes contact@gmail.com. Confirm the intended official address; no association or delivery is certified.

findings.title: Label the required message editor
findings.detail: The captured primary message textarea has no programmatic label, despite a visible Message prompt.

findings.title: Homepage rendering was not established
findings.detail: The declared French homepage produced an empty normal-browser capture, while contact and procedure text rendered. This is an operator collection limitation, not an outage or site-wide failure conclusion.

categories.label: External Security Posture and Technical Privacy

rows.label: HTTPS enforced
rows.reason: The declared HTTP entry upgraded to trusted HTTPS without an observed downgrade. Credit is limited to this captured entry chain.

rows.label: Valid TLS certificate
rows.reason: Hostname/date/chain-verified HTTPS succeeded with the separately root-verified public intermediates supplied to the recovery Node process. Default Node chain construction failed on some hosts; this is not evidence of complete server-delivered chains or universal client compatibility. See the recovery amendment.

rows.label: Modern TLS configuration
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Full protocol/cipher assessment, not one negotiated connection. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: HSTS present and meaningful
rows.reason: Captured HSTS policies were parsed against the frozen rule: full requires max-age at least one year with includeSubDomains; a valid positive narrower policy earns half; absent, disabled or malformed earns zero. Worst declared page governs.

rows.label: Content-Security-Policy present and meaningful
rows.reason: The representative fresh homepage and contact responses have no CSP header; their meta policy is only upgrade-insecure-requests. It does not restrict script/object sources, so the frozen meaningful-policy rule awards zero. The excluded service-page collector error was not treated as evidence of missing policy.

rows.label: Other important security headers
rows.reason: Reviewed nosniff, DENY/SAMEORIGIN or restrictive frame-ancestors, and explicit meaningful Referrer-Policy values. Full needs all three protections, half some, zero none; worst sampled page governs.

rows.label: Secure cookie configuration
rows.reason: Only attributes of observed cookies are reviewed. Full requires Secure, HttpOnly and explicit Lax/Strict on all; partial means mixed protections. No names/values or complete consent/tracking audit are published.

rows.label: No mixed HTTP/HTTPS content
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Browser and sampled-page evidence. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: Responsiveness
rows.reason: Worst median lab TBT 348 ms; full/half limits 200/600 ms. Explicit lab proxy, not field INP.

rows.label: Cumulative Layout Shift
rows.reason: Worst median lab CLS 0.2897; full/half limits 0.1/0.25. Sampled navigation only.

rows.label: Server response and first content
rows.reason: Worst median FCP 6589 ms and document response audit 337 ms. Full 1800/800; half 3000/1800. Response excludes connection/redirect time.

rows.label: Resource and page-weight efficiency
rows.reason: Worst median transfer 2897940 bytes, 182 requests. Full decimal 2MB/80; half 4MB/150.

rows.label: Performance consistency

rows.label: Verified WCAG 2.2 issue set
rows.reason: The normal-browser contact sample verifies the required message editor lacks a programmatic label. This concrete critical field-name defect prevents sampled issue-set credit; the empty homepage capture and other incomplete observations are not treated as accessibility failures.

rows.label: Color contrast
rows.reason: The retained rendered contact/service screenshots show the small gold identity/link styles captured as #907b00 on white, about 4.18:1 at 13px regular, below 4.5:1. Partial credit records this repeated accent-text defect. The blank homepage capture was excluded from this judgment, and no failure is inferred from a collector blank page.

rows.label: Form labels, instructions and errors

The matching normal-browser axe label check confirms no alternative accessible name. This critical primary-message-field defect prevents sampled form-access credit; validation/submission was not exercised.

Partial credit recognizes usable titles; the excluded service capture prevents broader claims.

rows.label: Sitemap/crawlability configuration
rows.reason: The captured sitemap endpoint returned a successful XML sitemap index or URL set. This establishes observed crawl configuration, not search-engine indexing or completeness.

rows.label: Clean URLs, canonicalization and redirects
rows.reason: The retained representative homepage and contact documents load over HTTPS but advertise HTTP canonical URLs for those same pages. The captured HTTP entry itself redirects to HTTPS, so the canonical signal conflicts with observed transport enforcement. Partial credit records this specific inconsistency; it is not a claim that the browser actually downgraded. The excluded third page remains unverified.

rows.label: Functional site search and discoverability
rows.reason: Submitted the benign keyword through a previously observed GET search action and field, without guessing a route. The supplementary document returned HTTP 200 and displayed relevant matching content, including ministry appointments and public-security announcements. The implementing evaluator reviewed the result headings/text. This awards only the observed query, not every search term or destination.
